items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for the fleet; blocked for SearchWoot public launch. Fleet-doctor is unavailable (ok=false, no run or checks), and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable, so authentication, access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency risk, monitoring, and incident readiness cannot be confirmed. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this is not a complete TLS review. Compliance reports 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; this is not certification. Security.txt, disclosure readiness, secret exposure, container isolation, dependency provenance, and data-exposure evidence are unknown. Recommend bounded read-only evidence capture only, preserve the private launch gate, and do not claim clean security or authorize public exposure.
